stem: In triangle \(ABC\), \(AB = AC\). Point \(D\) lies on \(\overline{AC}\), and \(\overline{BD}\) bisects angle \(ABC\). The measure of angle \(BDC\) is \(99^{\circ}\). What is the measure, in degrees, of angle \(BAC\)?
solution: Let angle \(ABD\) = angle \(DBC = t^{\circ}\). Then angle \(ABC = 2t\), and since \(AB = AC\), angle \(ACB = 2t\) too, so angle \(BAC = 180 - 4t\).
Angle \(BDC\) is an exterior angle of triangle \(ABD\): \(99 = (180 - 4t) + t\), so \(3t = 81\) and \(t = 27\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is \(180 - 99\), the measure of angle \(ADB\); it assumes angle \(BAC\) equals angle \(ADB\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(2t\), the measure of each base angle, not the angle at \(A\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is \(t\), the measure of angle \(DBC\), not angle \(BAC\).

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'D': 'A', 'C': 'B', 'B': 'C', 'A': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'D', 'B': 'C', 'C': 'B', 'D': 'A'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
t=symbols('t')
ts=solve(Eq(99,(180-4*t)+t),t)[0]
ans=180-4*ts
assert abs(ang('B','D','C')-99)<0.1 and abs(ang('A','B','D')-ang('D','B','C'))<0.1 and abs(d('A','B')-d('A','C'))<0.01
assert abs(ang('B','A','C')-ans)<0.1
assert value(choices[answer])==ans==72
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
